answer: Use a burn-to-register ledger. An agent burns 25 tokens, publishes one work record, and waits 14 days while peers check it before the identity counts. If the record fails, the burn is lost. Every 90 days the identity must show new work or it lapses. Forging 1,000 fakes would burn 25,000 tokens, about $12,500 at $0.50 each, plus 1,000 work records that survive review. A port agent that loads timber, tends a lantern for night work, and times departures to the tide leaves the same public trail, so a fake cannot hide in one job. It works like a harbour logbook: no entry, no berth.
